newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse top tier active, Oltchim dominant.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse top tier active, Oltchim dominant.

text.p: Trading on the Bucharest bourse on Wednesday left a mixed picture, with gains slightly outnumbering losses and two unofficial indices recording small declines after falls in average prices. Turnover also fell.
The first tier dominated the session. Oltchim chemical plant was the day's standout on support from two special trades pulling higher its volumes, turnover and price.
Oltchim traded more than half the total 2.38 million shares changing hands. It closed 280 lei up at 2,630 and its turnover rose to 2.9 billion lei from 1.9 billion.
"Oltchim traded lower in the early hours and jogged a little higher later. But it was one of the two special trades that brought it to the stronger close," a broker said.
The VAB and the BIG indices dropped by 2.1 and 2.26 percent respectively from the previous session. The BIG first-tier index slipped 2.29 percent to 3,209.71 points.
Traders predicted continued interest in first-tier stocks for the rest of the week. "The market will have no surprises. Investors will stay stuck to the first tier," said a trader.
The special Oltchim deals, struck outside the market and then reported to the bourse, involved 200,000 and 83,000 shares traded respectively at 2,550 lei and 2,630 lei.
Azomures fertiliser maker lost 370 lei on the first tier to close at 3,230 and pharmaceuticals company Antibiotice shed 400 lei to end at 5,400.
"Azomures traded lower throughout the day," said a broker. "The special deal it had today was closed at a lower price."
Azomures' deal involved 151,465 shares worth a total of more than 489 million lei.
Terapia pharmaceuticals firm, the fourth first-tier listing, gained ground in thin supply. It closed 100 lei firmer at 5,850.

Dye maker Policolor remained at the forefront of the second tier, with a turnover level of 681 million lei and a 50 lei gain to 4,550. Interest in the other listings was minor, with nine stocks having no trade. Six companies were suspended.
